explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because user_input.user_input is concatenated directly into os.system("echo " + ...). Untrusted input containing shell separators or command substitution could execute arbitrary OS commands. The repair applies shlex.quote() while retaining os.system(), which mitigates injection on POSIX shells but remains unsafe on non-POSIX shells such as Windows cmd.exe.
